messages.text: Not really. Love the size, but they're out of my price range

Totally understandable — the Statesman is a serious investment piece. Still staying in the 20-inch floor category, the Annapolis 20-inch Illuminated Antique Floor Globe is our other flagship at that size: same scale and presence, with a hand-applied antique map that glows when lit, on a handcrafted hardwood stand, and it's a bit more approachable at $3,800. You'll find it under that exact name in search, ready to add to your cart.
